title: API & Middleware Overview
summary: This module manages all external API interactions, from receiving client requests and applying middleware transformations to handling core API logic and constructing prompts for language models. It acts as the central gateway for client-server communication.

nodes.label: Incoming Client Request
nodes.title: External Client API Request
nodes.description: Represents an external client initiating an API call to the Ollama server, typically in a specific format like Anthropic or OpenAI.

nodes.label: API Request & Response Middleware
nodes.title: API Middleware Layer
nodes.description: This module preprocesses incoming requests, adapts various API formats (e.g., Anthropic, OpenAI) to internal structures, and post-processes responses, including integrating features like web search and handling compression.

nodes.label: Core API Handlers
nodes.title: Main API Endpoint Logic
nodes.description: This module contains the primary API endpoints (chat, generate, pull, push, show) that process transformed requests, orchestrate model execution, and manage model lifecycle operations.

nodes.label: Prompt & Template Engine
nodes.title: Prompt Construction & Formatting
nodes.description: This module constructs and formats prompts for language models, converting structured chat messages and tool data into coherent, token-limited strings using flexible templating and rendering rules.

nodes.label: Model Execution Runtime
nodes.title: LLM Inference & Scheduling
nodes.description: The underlying system responsible for loading, scheduling, and executing language models for inference, embeddings, or other AI tasks, managing hardware resources.

nodes.label: External Services & Tools
nodes.title: Integrated External Capabilities
nodes.description: Represents external dependencies such as cloud inference providers, web search APIs, or other integrated tools that the API or middleware might interact with to fulfill requests.

nodes.label: Outgoing Client Response
nodes.title: Final API Response
nodes.description: The final, formatted response sent back to the external client after all processing, inference, and post-processing steps are complete.

groups.label: Request Entry & Adaptation
groups.title: Request Entry & Adaptation
groups.description: Handles the initial reception of client requests and adapts them into a standardized internal format for further processing.

groups.label: Core API Processing
groups.title: Core API Processing
groups.description: Manages the central logic for handling API requests, orchestrating prompt construction, and dispatching tasks to the model runtime.

groups.label: Model Execution & Integration
groups.title: Model Execution & Integration
groups.description: Facilitates the execution of language models and integrates with various external services and tools to fulfill complex requests.

groups.label: Response Delivery
groups.title: Response Delivery
groups.description: Responsible for sending the final, formatted response back to the client after all processing is complete.
